returns 0 when `ecx` is 0; otherwise calls `0017D260(ecx*0x18, 8)`, returns that result as is when it is null, and else copies `ecx` 0x18-byte entries from `rdx` into it (16 bytes by `movups` plus a qword by `movsd` each, skipping a null destination slot without advancing `rdx`) and returns the buffer

passes `rdx+0x58` to the call at `006C0B50` + 0x16; when bit 31 of dword `rdx+0x10` is clear and qword `rdx+0x18` is non-null, calls `00584730` on that qword; then zeroes qword `rdx+0x18` and dword `rdx+0x10` and returns 1 in `al`

passes `rdx+0x50` to the call at `006C4B70` + 0x16; when dword `rdx+0x20` has bit 31 clear and is above 1 (unsigned) and qword `rdx+0x28` is non-null, calls `00584730` on that qword; then zeroes qword `rdx+0x28` and dword `rdx+0x20` and returns 1 in `al`
when dword `[rcx]` has bit 31 clear and is above 1 (unsigned) and qword `rcx+8` is non-null, calls `00584730` on that qword; then zeroes dword `[rcx]` and qword `rcx+8`, leaving 0 in `rax`

stores the address `00D86960` at qword `[rcx]` and `00D86AD0` at qword `rcx+8`, then tail-jumps to `0016D6A0(rcx+0x880)`
stores the address `00D89A80` at qword `[rcx]`, calls `00809054(rcx+0x60, 0x20, 2, 006CC410)`, calls `00809950(rcx, 0xa8)` only when bit 0 of `edx` is set, and returns `rcx`
calls `00584730` on qword `rdx+0x40` and then on qword `rdx+0x28`, each only when that qword is non-null with bit 0 clear; then passes `rdx` to the call at `006CDD30` + 0x43 and returns 1 in `al`

notes: Doubts per function. Callees the page does not name (the shared tail call of 006AF910 and 006CDD30, the +0x16 calls) are cited by call site. 006AF910/006CDD30: the bit-0 test is 'not al; test al,1; je skip', so 00584730 runs only when bit 0 of the qword is clear; both call the same unnamed site callee with rdx. 006C0B50/006C4B70/006C52D0: the bit-31 test uses the same idiom (shr 0x1f; not al), so the free runs only when bit 31 is clear. 006BC540: the inner null test on the destination slot can never fire for a non-null buffer; rdx advances only when a slot is copied. 006C7D00: the r8d == 1 path tests rcx+8 for null (always non-null). Blend family 006D7380..006D84A0: weights are tested with ucomiss against 0.0, and jp/jne treat NaN as non-zero; when [rcx] is 0.0 the code reloads the uninitialised local slot 0, which the next collected weight overwrites; the 1.0 test is ucomiss/jp/jne (exactly 1.0, not NaN); the scaled path uses mulps by 8 and 4 floats plus a scalar tail; summation order differs per arm (e.g. two-source arm computes w1*s1 + w0*s0), stated as a plain sum. 006D7380/006D7630/006D78E0 tail-jump and have no cookie; 006D7BA0/006D7EA0/006D81A0/006D84A0 call and finish through the cookie check (00808C40 is named by the page). In the three-weight bodies the unreachable four-source arm would read the cookie slot as a source pointer. No skips.
